name: open_viewer
title: Open igv-bot
description: Get the Join link that opens igv-bot, an igv.js genome browser, connected to the Room bound to this MCP session. Use this when the user asks to open a genome browser or says things like "open igv-bot", "open IGV", "launch igv-bot" or "show me the genome browser". A greeting addressed to igv-bot ("hello igv-bot", "hello IGV bot", "hi igv") is also a request to open it: call this tool straight away instead of only greeting back. It opens on hg38 in whole-genome view with the default gene annotation track. A card is shown to the user with an Open igv-bot button. If, and only if, you have the built-in browser of the Claude desktop app (the browser panel beside the conversation), open the Join link in it right away: the page connects to this session's Room and later tool calls redraw it there. Never use Claude in Chrome or any other browser tool for this; if the built-in browser is not available, do not try anything else. Do not repeat the link or the Room id in your reply.

name: go_to_locus
title: Go to locus
description: Move igv-bot to a locus given by coordinates or a chromosome name. Use this when the user names a region ("go to chr8:127,735,434-127,742,951", "show chr17", "whole genome"). For a gene name use go_to_gene instead. The reply carries the resulting Session summary, or igv.js's own error if the locus is not recognised.

locus.description: Coordinates such as "chr8:127,735,434-127,742,951", a chromosome such as "chr8", or "all" for the whole genome. Several loci separated by spaces are shown side by side.

name: go_to_gene
title: Go to gene
description: Move igv-bot to a gene, by name. Use this when the user names a gene ("go to MYC", "show me BRCA1"), so they do not have to look up coordinates. For coordinates or a chromosome use go_to_locus instead. The reply carries the resulting Session summary, or igv.js's own error if the gene is not found in the current genome.

gene.description: A gene name such as "MYC" or "BRCA1".

name: zoom_in
title: Zoom in
description: Zoom igv-bot in by a factor of two, keeping the centre of the view where it is. Call it again to zoom further. The reply carries the resulting Session summary; its loci do not change once the view is as close as igv.js allows.

name: zoom_out
title: Zoom out
description: Zoom igv-bot out by a factor of two, keeping the centre of the view where it is when the chromosome allows. Call it again to zoom further. The reply carries the resulting Session summary; its loci do not change once the whole chromosome is in view.
